Product Features

  • The exquisite high-gloss coffee table creates a luxurious and elegant aesthetic and comfortable living environment with its appearance. It is not only a coffee table, but also a pursuit of the perfect life.
  • The white tabletop and the black base give the living room an elegant style.
  • The height above the ground is convenient for the robot sweeper to pass, which makes cleaning easy and convenient
  • Multifunctional double-layer coffee table, the top white coffee table can be rotated 360 degrees to meet your various needs

  • The coffee table is designed as a whole, and the thick and practical materials enhance the overall support. At the same time, it ensures that the square coffee table is durable, does not deform, and has a long service life.
